scripts.content:gen: npm run build:content && node scripts/contentgen.ts gen
scripts.dev: npm run build:content && npm run dev -w @reborn/web
scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w @reborn/web && npm run build:demo
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build:content && npm run dev -w @reborn/demo
scripts.build:demo: BASE_PATH=${PAGES_BASE:-}/demo/ npm run build -w @reborn/demo && rm -rf apps/web/out/demo && cp -r apps/demo/dist apps/web/out/demo
